verdict.rationale: First-party docs show several natural-language ways to operate Browserbase. You can create an Agent in the dashboard by describing the goal in plain language (docs-16), Stagehand offers natural-language selectors and actions (docs-5), and a paused run continues once you reply in conversation (docs-23). Skills and an official MCP server also let coding agents such as Claude Code drive the platform from natural-language prompts (docs-15, probe-3). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language operation works reliably, and evidence that session and infrastructure management (not just task execution) can be done fully through natural language.
